title: UI CSS
description: CSS text a page links, served at a versioned URL.

rbac_context.description: The context the item's write is authorized in on its branch.

branch.description: The name of the branch the item is on; main when absent.

deleted.description: true: a deletion marker, hiding the base's CSS of this name on this branch. It needs only a name.

base.description: Server-managed: the ETag of the parent branch's CSS this one overrides, or null.

name.description: The CSS item's name, unique on its branch. A name with a prefix (abc:name) may only override an installed UI layer's item of this kind; the scrud: prefix is reserved.

css.description: The CSS text. It may not contain "</style".

order.description: Items are linked in order, then by name.
